{{- /*
  Site index for LLMs and agents (https://llmstxt.org/).
  Overrides hextra's layouts/llms.txt to:
  - Prefer each page's front matter description over a truncated summary.
  - Link a page's Markdown version when the site builds one.
  - List section index pages, not only their children.
  - List any full-text outputs (llms-full*, llms-rules) the site builds.
  Set `llms: false` in a page's front matter to leave it out.
*/ -}}
# {{ .Site.Title }}

> {{ .Site.Params.description | default "" }}

{{- $full := slice }}
{{- $langs := slice }}
{{- $rules := slice }}
{{- range site.Home.OutputFormats }}
  {{- if or (eq .Name "llmsfull") (eq .Name "llms-full") }}{{ $full = $full | append . }}
  {{- else if or (eq .Name "llmsrules") (eq .Name "llms-rules") }}{{ $rules = $rules | append . }}
  {{- else if and (hasPrefix .Name "llms") (ne .Name "llms") }}{{ $langs = $langs | append . }}
  {{- end }}
{{- end }}
{{- if or $full $langs $rules }}

## Full text
{{- range $full }}
- [Full guide, all languages]({{ .Permalink }}): Every page of the guide with code examples in every language.
{{- end }}
{{- range $langs }}
- [Full guide, {{ strings.TrimPrefix "llms-" .Name | strings.TrimPrefix "llms" }} only]({{ .Permalink }}): Every page of the guide with only {{ strings.TrimPrefix "llms-" .Name | strings.TrimPrefix "llms" }} code examples.
{{- end }}
{{- range $rules }}
- [Rules only (optional)]({{ .Permalink }}): Every page of the guide without code examples.
{{- end }}
{{- end }}

{{- $rootPages := where (where site.RegularPages "Section" "") "Params.llms" "ne" false }}
{{- if $rootPages }}

## Root Pages
{{- range $rootPages }}
{{ template "llms-entry" . }}
{{- end }}
{{- end }}
{{ range (where site.Sections "Params.llms" "ne" false).Reverse }}
{{- template "llms-section-tree" dict "context" . "level" 2 }}
{{ end }}

---
Generated on {{ now.UTC.Format "2006-01-02 15:04:05 MST" }}
Site: {{ .Site.BaseURL }}

{{- define "llms-entry" -}}
{{- $url := .Permalink -}}
{{- with .OutputFormats.Get "markdown" }}{{ $url = .Permalink }}{{ end -}}
{{- $desc := .Description -}}
{{- if not $desc -}}
  {{- $desc = .Summary | plainify | htmlUnescape | replaceRE `\s+` " " | strings.TrimSpace | truncate 100 -}}
{{- end -}}
- [{{ .Title }}]({{ $url }}){{ with $desc }}: {{ . }}{{ end }}{{ if not .Date.IsZero }} - Published {{ .Date.Format "2006-01-02" }}{{ end }}
{{- end -}}

{{- define "llms-section-tree" -}}
{{- $context := .context -}}
{{- $level := .level | default 2 -}}
{{- $headerHashes := strings.Repeat $level "#" -}}
{{- "\n" -}}
{{ $headerHashes }} {{ $context.Title }}
{{ template "llms-entry" $context }}
{{- range where $context.RegularPages "Params.llms" "ne" false }}
{{ template "llms-entry" . }}
{{- end }}

{{- range where $context.Sections "Params.llms" "ne" false }}
{{ template "llms-section-tree" dict "context" . "level" (add $level 1) }}
{{- end }}
{{- end -}}
